main_text.p: gentium, Psal.22.28. Aff. לִמְשַׁפְּחוֹתָיו Per familias suas, Numer.11.10.

שפט Judicavit, Judicium exercuit, Judicem egit, Jus dixit, Sententiam tulit: Praeterit. שָׁפַט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל Judicaverat Israëlem, Jud.16.31. id est, Rexerat, Jure & justitiâ vindicaverat: וּשְׁפַטְתֶּם צֶדֶק Judicate justitiâ, id est, Juste, pro בְּצֶדֶק, Deut.1.16. Part. שֹׁפֵט Judicans & Judex. Niph. נִשְׁפַּט Judicatus fuit, Judicium subiit: In jus venit, Disceptavit, Contendit: Praeter. loco Futuri, יִשָּׁפֵט Disceptabit, Judicem exhibebit se, Jesa.66.16. נִשְׁפַּטְתִּי אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם Disceptavi cum majoribus vestris, Ezech.20.36. וְנִשְׁפַּטְתִּי אִתּוֹ Et disceptabo cum illo, Ezech.17.20. & sic plerumq; cum אֶת loco Praepositionis עִם Cum, construitur. Pih. Praeterit. cum Cholem loco Dagesch, הִיא שׁוֹפְטָה Ipsa judicabat Israëlem, Jud.4.4. Particip. לְמִשְׁפְּטִי Judicanti me, Judici meo, Job.9.15.
שֹׁפֵט m. Judicans, Judex, ut antè dictum: Aff. שָׁפְטֵנוּ Judex noster, Jesa.33.22. Plural. שֹׁפְטִים Judices, &c.
שָׁפָּט m. Chald. Idem: Plural. מִנֵּי שָׁפְטִין Constitue judices, Esr.7.25.
שִׁפּוּט m. Judicium, id est, Vindicta, Plaga, 2.Par.20.9. Plural. cum Schurek, שִׁפּוּטִים Judicia, Ezech.23.10. Id Kimchi deducit à sing. שִׁפּוּט forma זְבוּל.

מִשְׁפָּט m. Judicium, Jus: Metaphoricè: Ratio, Mos, Ritus, Modus: Semel absolutè מִשְׁפָּט Levit.24.v.22. Kimchi plura talia notat in Michlol, in quibus nostra exemplaria variant. Vide רמס. Constr. מִשְׁפַּט־צֶדֶק Judicio justitiâ, id est, justo, Deut.16.18. Aff. עַל־מִשְׁפָּטוֹ Pro ratione sua, Jer.30.18. Plural. אַדֶּבֶר מִשְׁפָּטִים Eloquar jura eis, Jerem.
